LESSON: THE CALL OF MOSES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.8: The call of Moses

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The call of Moses
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why did God call Moses?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The call of Moses.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why did God call Moses?
2. How did Moses portray obedience to God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain ways Christian leaders obey God’s instructions today

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
